newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan leading index 44.4, coincident 90.0 - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan leading index 44.4, coincident 90.0 - EPA.

text.p: Japan's diffusion index of leading economic indicators stood at 44.4 on a scale of 100 in January, falling below the the so-called "boom or bust" mark of 50 for the first time in five months, the Economic Planning Agency (EPA) said on Monday.
The following is a breakdown of the indices of economic indicators:
The EPA said in statement that the data showed Japan's economy was continuing to recover.
A figure for the leading index below 50 is generally taken as suggesting the economy will contract in the coming months.
The coincident index, which measures current economic conditions, stayed above 50 in January for a fifth straight month.
The lagging index, which traces economic trends in the past few months, was below 50 in January for the first time in four months.
